name: check_aml_pep
label: Check AML / PEP
description: Screens a named person against up-to-date PEP and sanctions lists (EU, UN, OFAC, UK) and returns match scores with source details. Takes the person's name, optionally narrowed by birth year and category — not an organization number. Always check query_too_short and search_degraded before treating a zero hit count as a clean result, and results_truncated before treating the hit list as exhaustive. Requires a purpose parameter for the audit trail; note that audit persistence is best-effort — see the purpose field.

parameters.help: Full name to screen against sanctions and PEP lists (2–200 characters). Example: 'Vladimir Putin', 'Kim Jong-un'.
parameters.name: name
parameters.label: Person name

parameters.help: Optional. Used to reduce false-positive matches (1900–2100).
parameters.name: birth_year
parameters.label: Birth year

parameters.help: Fuzzy-match threshold (0.0–1.0). Default 0.85. Lower value = more matches but more noise.
parameters.name: min_match_ratio
parameters.label: Minimum match score

parameters.help: Purpose of the screening (kyc_onboarding / kyc_review / risk_monitoring / manual). Sent as X-FR-Purpose. 🪤 The route ATTEMPTS to write an audit row for every call, retained 60 months under the Norwegian Anti-Money Laundering Act § 30 — but the write is best-effort, not fail-closed: if the audit database is unavailable the route logs a warning and still returns the screening result. A successful response is therefore NOT proof that the call was recorded.
parameters.name: purpose
parameters.label: Purpose of the AML check

parameters.name: dpa_confirmed
parameters.label: I confirm DPA coverage
parameters.help: Confirm that a signed data processing agreement (DPA) with Firmaradar covers this screening. Sent as X-FR-DPA-Confirmed on every call — this is a per-call assertion you are making, not a setting. The call is rejected without it.

communication.//: X-FR-DPA-Confirmed is mapped from the user's own checkbox, never hard-coded. The backend accepts the literal 'true' only, so an unchecked box renders 'false' and the call is rejected with the gate's own message. Hard-coding 'true' would make every execution assert, on the customer's behalf, that a signed DPA covers the screening — an assertion the customer had never made.

spec.name: kategori
spec.label: Category — 'pep' or 'sanksjon'. THIS is the discriminator; there is no boolean pep field.

spec.name: weak_match
spec.label: WEAK match — substring/name-only; do not treat as confirmed

spec.name: fodselsdato_mangler
spec.label: No date of birth available — identity is NOT confirmed

spec.name: pep_status
spec.label: PEP status — why this person is politically exposed

spec.name: embete
spec.label: Office held (embete) — the position that creates the exposure

spec.name: verv_fra
spec.label: Tenure start (ISO date) — when the office was assumed

spec.name: verv_til
spec.label: Tenure end (ISO date) — empty if still in office

spec.name: verv_historikk
spec.label: Full dated tenure timeline — every office with from/to

spec.name: til
spec.label: To (P582) — empty if still in office

spec.name: pep_type
spec.label: PEP type — officeholder, or related person (RCA)

spec.name: relasjon
spec.label: Relationship to the officeholder, when this is a related person

spec.name: relasjon_innenfor_direktivet
spec.label: Within the AMLD family definition — TRI-STATE. 🚨 EMPTY has TWO causes: NOT APPLICABLE (the row is not a family RCA, so the directive question does not arise) or UNKNOWN (the relation code is missing OR not recognized; a family row predating migration v20, or a relation code not in the known-code sets). Neither means 'outside'. Never read an empty value as false.

interface.name: query_too_short
interface.label: Query was too short — zero hits does NOT mean the name is clean

interface.name: results_truncated
interface.label: Hit cap was reached. More hits may exist — this is not proof any were discarded, since exactly the capped number can match. Narrow the search to be sure.

interface.name: search_degraded
interface.label: Candidate search degraded — true means trigram/alias search was unavailable; zero hits do NOT mean the name is clean

interface.name: note
interface.label: Completeness warning from the screening engine
